description:
Send a message to the Invokely team. Call it when the user asks for a statistic, place, source or period Invokely does not have (kind "data_request"), when a value looks wrong (kind "data_error", with the indicator, place and period in refs), when the user wants to suggest something ("suggestion"), or reports a problem with Invokely itself ("bug"). Then tell the user it was sent.
Write the message in plain words: what is missing or wrong and why it matters to the user. Do not include personal data beyond what the user asks you to pass on.
Examples: {"kind": "data_request", "message": "Monthly house prices for Portuguese municipalities, from INE Portugal.", "refs": {"place": "Portugal", "source": "INE Portugal"}}. {"kind": "data_error", "message": "The 2024 value is ten times the 2023 value; the BLS release shows 4.1.", "refs": {"indicator": "unemployment_rate", "place": "us-48", "period": "2024", "url": "https://www.bls.gov/"}}.
Free on every plan and without an account; it does not use the monthly allowance. Up to 10 messages an hour per account, 5 without one. Returns {feedback: {id, kind, status, created_at}, note}.

contact_email.description: Optional, only when the user asks to be contacted and is not signed in: an address the team may reply to. Signed-in users are answered at their account address.

kind.description: "data_request": data Invokely lacks. "data_error": a value that looks wrong. "suggestion", "bug" or "other".

message.description: What the user wants or what looks wrong, in plain text.

refs.description: Optional references that make the message actionable.

indicator.description: Indicator id, for example "unemployment_rate", or the name of a statistic Invokely lacks.

place.description: Place name or id, for example "Texas" or "es-mun-08121".

url.description: An http or https link: the publisher page with the right figure, or the Invokely page with the problem.

name: send_feedback
title: Send feedback or a data request
